text:
maya: Quick check: exporting heatmap as SVG for docs showed banding when zoomed. Looks fine rasterized but SVG gradients are stepping. Anyone seen this?
liam: Yep, SVG stops + gamma differences cause that. We use CSS gradients in the docs site which get interpolated differently in Safari vs Chrome.
anya: Is this related to the palette itself or the export method? Could we use discrete steps for the legend and a continuous for the canvas?
liam: Technically both. Continuous gradient + CSS color interpolation can be non-perceptual. For tiny legend swatches I'd advocate discrete bins (5-6 stops) with consistent stops. That avoids banding on vector exports.
joy: Accessibility note: discrete steps also help screen-reader captions. If we label each swatch with numeric ranges it's clearer than vague labels.
maya: Good point. Proposal: make legend swatches discrete with micro-labels (e.g., "0-5%"), keep map continuous on canvas but use a perceptual colormap (viridis-ish). Also add a 1px inner stroke to each swatch so outlines don't disappear on dark bg.
liam: CSS for export-friendly swatches (example):
```css
.legend-swatch { width: 28px; height: 12px; stroke: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); stroke-width: 1; }
.legend-swatch[data-step="0"] { fill: #081019; background-image: url('/patterns/dots.svg'); }
```
anya: Love the pattern fallback for the lowest bucket. For the canvas cells we should avoid adding DOM nodes per cell for perf. Maybe render a subtle dot layer into the canvas for those buckets during export only.
design-bot: Accessibility scan: legend text #a1b0bd on bg #071018 => contrast 4.2:1. Small text fails AA. Suggested actions: increase to #c3d0dd or use semi-bold for <12px.
joy: Also: exported SVGs must include <title> and <desc> tags for alt text. Caption should explain mapping and whether lowest bucket uses pattern overlay. Example caption: "Token frequency heatmap. Color scale: 0-5% (hashed), 6-20% (navy), 21-60% (teal), >60% (cyan)." Keep it concise.
maya: Action items: (1) Liam - discrete legend + stroke + pattern export prototype (2) Anya - update copy for legend labels and captions (3) Joy - verify AA contrast for final swatches. I'll add these to the sprint board.
liam: I'll push a prototype branch with SVG export tweaks and a small demo page.
anya: One tiny UI nit: in dark mode, hover cards over the legend are using translucent blur which reads like a lighter halo. Can we try a denser backdrop (rgba(3,6,10,0.78)) so it doesn't look like a ghost layer?
joy: +1 on stronger backdrop. Also ensure tooltip text is >=12px and bold if contrast hovers in 4.5:1 borderline.
maya: Thanks all. If Liam posts the branch ping here and I'll do a quick UX pass. Ending thread for now — will reopen after prototype.
